One caution: The manufacturer's individual Mole product page currently says sold out, while its catalog advertises $194. Confirm that the Standard Kit can actually be added to your cart before relying on that price.

At $179–$194, the Mole is an attractive budget option for medium-sized objects. At $649, I'd consider the newer Moose instead.

Are you planning to use it for 3D printing, reverse engineering, or scanning people/objects? That would help determine whether the Mole is the right scanner for you.
